result.description:
WHO ARE WE   

   

 Our cient is located on the Eastern shore of Hobart, at the heart of the Lindisfarne Village commercial and retail precinct. 

   

 We are consistently recognised for the high quality of dentistry and service we have provided over the past 38 years and ongoing. Our client is recommended by some of Lindisfarne’s most exclusive businesses, clubs, and residents to their members. 

   

 A great place to practice, enhance your skills and learn from experienced dentists. 

   

   WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR   

   

 · You must love being a dentist, be proud of your work and care about your patient's long-term oral health. 

   

 · An experienced dentist who shares our values of dental excellence 

   

 · You believe in making a meaningful impact in the community we serve. 

   

 · You are a great team player and communicator 

   

  SKILLS AND QUALITIES WE ARE LOOKING FOR  

 
	 Minimum 2-year experience as a dental practitioner. New graduates will also be considered. 
	 Be passionate about making a positive impact on the patient's dental journey. 
	 Have an exceptional ability to communicate and build rapport with patients. 
	 Build cooperation and teamwork in working with like-minded professionals. 
	 Have a growth and professional development mindset. 
	 Be respectful and appreciative of team members. 
	 Contribute to the practice running smoothly and professionally. 
 

   WHAT WE OFFER   

 As a preferred provider for almost all major health funds, we offer all aspects of modern dentistry including dental implant therapy, cosmetic and general dentistry. Our client is equipped with the latest technologies, including Trios 5 scanner, Sirona Heliodent plus with digital x-rays, rotary instruments for endodontics, Dental 4 windows software and more. 

 You will be joining our team with busy books on a Full-time basis (4 days), with the capacity for an additional day if you are the right fit for the team. We continuously invest in our people, culture, technology, and systems. Every member of our team is encouraged and supported to be a driver and steward of growth. 

   

 If this sounds like you, we want to hear from you. Send us your resume and cover letter, outlining: 

 
	 Your clinical experience as a dentist 
	 Your approach to patient care and your unique communication style 
	 Why working as part of a team is important to you 
	 How your ‘can do’ attitude can contribute to a dental practice that’s going places. 
 

 Shortlisted candidates will hear from us via email.   Apply Now

A hands on Cyber Security Analyst from a Microsoft environment    
 Hays are engaged by a purpose-led brand within the NSW Government, who are hiring a mid-senior level security analyst to join their Cyber team. 
 This hire is an 80% hands-on technical role, where you are responsible for the day-to-day operation and configuration of the client's cybersecurity tools. The successful incumbent will support the Head of Cyber in detection, response and vulnerability management. 20% of the role will be focused on aligning to governance frameworks as and when needed. 
   
 Key responsibilities: 
 
 Security operations and detection (SIEM - Sentinel, EDR, XDR) 
 Vulnerability management 
 Security administration (Microsoft ecosystem, M365 stack) 
 
 Essential experience: 
 
 5 years of hands-on experience in IT operations and 3 specifically in a technical cybersecurity role. 
 Exposure to Microsoft technologies 
 Experience and knowledge of Essential Eight and ISM controls within Microsoft Azure & M365 environment 
 Ability to investigate and respond to security events. 
 
 This role gives the opportunity to be autonomous in configuration, but with the guidance and support of a Head of Cyber. You will get exposure to some of the latest tooling stack, Artificial intelligence and get ownership of project-based activities.

An exceptional opportunity has arisen for a dedicated full-time General Practitioner to join a well-established medical practice located in the heart of Kenmore, Queensland. Operating for over a decade, this highly regarded clinic has built a reputation for delivering premium healthcare and maintaining deep, multi-generational connections with the local community. The practice operates in a modern facility designed to optimize patient care and clinician comfort, featuring fully equipped consultation rooms and state-of-the-art medical equipment. Driven by rapid local growth and an escalating demand for healthcare services, the clinic is expanding its team to ensure the continuous delivery of comprehensive family medicine. 

 The incoming general practitioner will step into a highly supportive and collegiate team environment. The clinical workforce comprises a diverse group of experienced medical professionals, offering an excellent network for peer collaboration. Comprehensive operational support is a hallmark of this practice, which boasts an experienced Practice Manager and a friendly, efficient administrative team to streamline daily workflows. Furthermore, a dedicated team of skilled Registered Nurses provides robust assistance with chronic disease management (CDM), health assessments, immunizations, and treatment room procedures, allowing the GP to focus primarily on high-quality patient consultations. 

 Operating within a stable mixed-billing structure that balances accessible care with strong earning potential, the practice offers an attractive financial package. This includes an initial hourly guarantee or a competitive percentage of billings, whichever is greater, for the first three months to ensure a seamless transition. The position affords complete clinical autonomy, empowering the practitioner to practice medicine their own way while pursuing special interest opportunities such as skin cancer medicine, women’s or men’s health, and minor procedures. Practitioners are also highly encouraged to take on supervisor opportunities to mentor the next generation of registrars, with extensive support provided for ongoing continuing professional development (CPD) to facilitate continuous career growth. 

 Recognizing the importance of work-life balance, the practice offers highly flexible working arrangements across a five-day work week, allowing the successful candidate to tailor their roster around personal commitments. The lifestyle benefits of the Kenmore location further enhance this opportunity. Situated just 11 kilometers south-west of the Brisbane CBD, Kenmore is a prestigious, leafy residential suburb renowned for its family-friendly atmosphere, vibrant community spirit, and excellent local amenities. The area is highly sought after due to its proximity to some of Brisbane’s most elite educational institutions, including the Queensland Academy for Science, Mathematics and Technology, St Peters Lutheran College, Brisbane Boys College, Indooroopilly State High School, and Stuartholme School. This unique demographic ensures a diverse, stable, and rewarding patient base of young families, affluent professionals, and long-term residents.   Apply Now
